name: sparx — Life Coaching (Career)
tagline: A sharp template for career & executive coaches — book discovery calls from day one.
description: A sharp, empowering career-coaching site — a deep-navy palette, a confident amber accent and a modern sans, built for ambitious professionals. Installs a working booking flow: a free discovery call plus career-strategy, executive, leadership, interview-prep and promotion sessions, three coaches you book by name with evening hours, and a no-show policy. Ships as "Ascend Coaching", a results-focused practice you can book in about a minute.
